neighbours.label: (guess) a whole package of advantages just stated, about to be limited: 'all the benefits of …', 'the freedoms of a free software license, but …'
fire: This plan gives you all the benefits of a private pension without the paperwork.
An open license grants all the freedoms of public domain software, but adds a notice rule.
Members receive all the benefits of the premium service, minus the phone support.
The lease has the advantages of owning a car, without the repair bills.
A hybrid offers the benefits of an electric motor, but keeps a petrol tank.
Freelancers enjoy the benefits of a steady job, except for the paid holidays.
This course provides all the benefits of a full degree without the tuition.
A weak copyleft license keeps the freedoms of a free software license but allows linking.
quiet: This plan sends you a printed statement from a private pension every year.
An open meeting grants time for questions from the public in the town hall.
Members receive a card for the premium service, along with the phone number.
The lease has a page about the car and the repair shop's address.
A hybrid owner parked next to an electric charger and bought a coffee.
Freelancers work from a steady desk in the office on the paid holidays.
This course meets in a full lecture hall near the tuition office.
A weak signal kept the phone from a software update during the trip.

short: all the benefits of X, about to be limited (guess)
